about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Saint Joseph the Worker” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May these holy mysteries which we have received, O Lord, by the intercession of blessed Joseph, supply what is wanting in our works, and assure us of Thy rewards. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
